items.author: The Stacks Project Authors

items.difficulty_reason: Counts the author Lemma: for a locally Noetherian integral normal scheme X the map Pic(X) -> Cl(X) is injective (source lines 6873-6878). The proof takes an invertible module whose associated divisor class is trivial, chooses a regular meromorphic section s, multiplies by the inverse of the rational function realising the divisor to get a section t with zero divisor, and then shows t trivialises L: locally on an affine X = Spec(A) with A a Noetherian normal domain, vanishing of ord at all height one primes forces t into A and t^{-1} into A by the intersection of the localisations at height one primes.
